title: Impact of Enhanced Information on Subjective Information Level and PROMs in Patients with Aortic Stenosis
official: Impact of Enhanced Information Provision by Using a Mobile App on Subjective Information Level As the Basis for Shared-decision Making and Patient-reported Outcome Measures (PROMs) in Patients with Aortic Stenosis
summary: The aim of this trial is to evaluate if an enhanced information by using a mobile App can increase subjective information level in patients with severe aortic stenosis and may therefore improve patient-reported outcomes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* severe aortic valve stenosis
* planned aortic valve replacement (TAVI)
* Patient is willing and able to complete the surveys in German language
* Written informed consent by the trial subject

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Language barrier
sponsor: Heart and Diabetes Center North-Rhine Westfalia

sites.f: Clinic for General and Interventional Cardiology/Angiology, Herz- und Diabeteszentrum NRW
